en.tour.launch.title: Open LMU for Active Reset
en.tour.launch.text: Use Open LMU without EAC, then choose Offline Practice and enter DRIVE. Sector checks for Easy Anti-Cheat: when detected, Save/Restore and their shortcuts are blocked. Close the game before reopening it here. For online racing, open LMU normally with EAC; overlays remain available.
en.tour.checkpoint.title: Save a moment. Try it again.
en.tour.checkpoint.text: In LMU, press {save} to save your car's state, then {restore} to return to it. A new save replaces the previous checkpoint.
en.tour.shortcuts.title: Make the keys yours
en.tour.shortcuts.text: Click a shortcut, then press its new key. Choose unused game bindings. Return to LMU and release both keys before using them.
en.tour.audio.title: Hear the result
en.tour.audio.text: Enable confirmation sounds for saves, restores and rejected commands. Use the play buttons to listen to each success sound.
en.tour.connection.title: Know when you’re connected
en.tour.connection.text: Open offline Practice without EAC and enter driving. Sector connects automatically. Expand this bar to review status events, filter errors or export diagnostics.
en.tour.settings.title: Set your preferences
en.tour.settings.text: Open Edit → Settings to change app settings. Reduce motion minimizes interface animations. Preferences are saved automatically.
en.tour.overlay.title: Build your HUD
en.tour.overlay.text: Choose widgets, toggle their parts and adjust size or opacity. Edit layout lets you drag and resize them on your display. Lock layout returns clicks to the game.
en.tour.background.title: Keep driving with Sector
en.tour.background.text: Close the window to choose background mode or quit. Background keeps shortcuts active; reopen Sector from the tray or launcher. Quit stops the listener safely.
en.onboard.folder.title: Connect Le Mans Ultimate
en.onboard.folder.body: Confirm your LMU folder, or choose another.
en.onboard.tour.title: Ready for a quick tour?
en.onboard.tour.body: Learn how to save, restore and customize your overlays.
en.onboard.error.folder: Select the LMU folder to continue.
en.onboard.error.save: Could not save setup. Please try again.

zh-CN.launch.running: 想以无 EAC 方式启动，请先关闭 LMU。
zh-CN.launch.preview: 预览模式下无法启动游戏。
zh-CN.tour.progress: 快速指南，第 {index} 步 / 共 {total} 步
zh-CN.tour.launch.title: 为主动回点启动 LMU
zh-CN.tour.launch.text: 用无 EAC 方式打开 LMU，选择 Offline Practice 并进入 DRIVE。Sector 会检测 Easy Anti-Cheat：一旦检测到，保存、回到存档点及其快捷键都会被阻止。想重新在这里打开游戏，请先关闭它。线上比赛请带 EAC 正常启动 LMU，叠加层仍然可用。
zh-CN.tour.checkpoint.title: 存一个瞬间，随时重来
zh-CN.tour.checkpoint.text: 在 LMU 里按 {save} 保存车辆状态，想回来时按 {restore}。新的保存会覆盖上一个存档点。
zh-CN.tour.shortcuts.title: 换成你顺手的键
zh-CN.tour.shortcuts.text: 点一个快捷键，再按下新键。请挑游戏里没用到的键位。回到 LMU 后先松开这两个键再使用。
zh-CN.tour.audio.title: 听见每一次回点
zh-CN.tour.audio.text: 为保存、回到存档点和被拒绝的指令开启提示音。点播放按钮可以试听每种成功音效。
zh-CN.tour.connection.title: 随时知道是否连上
zh-CN.tour.connection.text: 用无 EAC 方式打开离线练习并进入驾驶，Sector 会自动连接。展开这条状态栏可以查看状态事件、筛选错误或导出诊断。
zh-CN.tour.settings.title: 调好你的偏好
zh-CN.tour.settings.text: 打开「编辑 > 设置」调整应用设置。减少动态效果会简化界面动画。偏好会自动保存。
zh-CN.tour.overlay.title: 搭好自己的 HUD
zh-CN.tour.overlay.text: 挑选小组件、开关它们的部件，并调整大小或透明度。编辑布局可以在显示器上拖动和缩放小组件；锁定布局会把点击交还给游戏。
zh-CN.tour.background.title: 关窗也能继续跑
zh-CN.tour.background.text: 关闭窗口可以选择后台模式或退出。后台模式让快捷键保持可用，从托盘或启动器重新打开 Sector；退出会安全地停止监听。
zh-CN.onboard.folder.title: 连接 Le Mans Ultimate
zh-CN.onboard.folder.body: 确认你的 LMU 安装文件夹，或另选一个。
zh-CN.onboard.tour.title: 来一次快速导览？
zh-CN.onboard.tour.body: 了解如何保存、回到存档点，以及自定义叠加层。
zh-CN.onboard.error.folder: 请选择 LMU 文件夹以继续。
